ModMetaData.name: Horax Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Horax art (south/east/ north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: TOTAL art redo for this SW canon creature, gathered from inspirational reference, never a rename. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Horax/Horax_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
UNVERIFIED as of authoring: the donor ships these textures inside a Unity AssetBundle (AssetBundles/, no loose Textures/swanimals/ folder at all), not as loose files. Loose-overrides-loose-by-load-order is proven elsewhere in this repo; loose-overrides-AssetBundle-by-load-order is NOT yet confirmed working for this donor - same open question as MynockArtOverride. Needs a live look (spawn/view a Horax in-game) before this mod is trusted.
